title: Ellie's immunity came with a price in The Last of Us
subject: ellie
description:
Would you have told Ellie the truth? 👇

The story of Ellie Williams, the immune girl from The Last of Us. Spoilers for The Last of Us Part I.

Fan-made content. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Naughty Dog or Sony Interactive Entertainment. Game images © their respective owners.

scenes.text: Ellie was 14 when one bite made her the most important person alive.
She and her best friend Riley were bitten in an abandoned mall. Riley turned, but Ellie didn't.
The Fireflies believed her body held the cure, so a smuggler named Joel was hired to carry her across a ruined America.
Then the price was revealed: making the cure meant surgery on her brain, and she wouldn't survive.
